1.w: At this also my heart pounds and leaps from its place.

2.w: Listen carefully to the thunder of his voice, to the rumbling that proceeds from his mouth.

3.w: Under the whole heaven he lets it go, even his lightning to the far corners of the earth.

4.w: After that a voice roars; he thunders with an exalted voice, and he does not hold back his lightning bolts when his voice is heard.

5.w: God thunders with his voice in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

6.w: For to the snow he says, ‘Fall to earth,’ and to the torrential rains, ‘Pour down.’

7.w: He causes everyone to stop working, so that all people may know his work.

8.w: The wild animals go to their lairs, and in their dens they remain.

9.w: A tempest blows out from its chamber, icy cold from the driving winds.

10.w: The breath of God produces ice, and the breadth of the waters freeze solid.

11.w: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through the clouds.

12.w: The clouds go round in circles, wheeling about according to his plans, to carry out all that he commands them over the face of the whole inhabited world.

13.w: Whether it is for punishment, or for his land, or for mercy, he causes it to find its mark.

14.w: “Pay attention to this, Job! Stand still and consider the wonders God works.

15.w: Do you know how God commands them, how he makes lightning flash in his storm cloud?

16.w: Do you know about the balancing of the clouds, that wondrous activity of him who is perfect in knowledge?

17.w: You, whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the south wind,

18.w: will you, with him, spread out the clouds, solid as a mirror of molten metal?

19.w: Tell us what we should say to him. We cannot prepare a case because of the darkness.

20.w: Should he be informed that I want to speak? If a man speaks, surely he will be swallowed up!

21.w: But now, the sun cannot be looked at — it is bright in the skies— after a wind passed and swept the clouds away.

22.w: From the north he comes in golden splendor; around God is awesome majesty.

23.w: As for the Almighty, we cannot attain to him! He is great in power, but justice and abundant righteousness he does not oppress.

24.w: Therefore people fear him, for he does not regard all the wise in heart.”
